newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania coalminers' leader to stay in custody.
newsitem.headline: Romania coalminers' leader to stay in custody.

text.p: A Romanian court ruled on Friday to extend an arrest warrant for coalminers' leader Miron Cosma, detained over his role in a 1991 riot which toppled the country's first post-communist government.

Bucharest's court of appeals granted a request by prosecutors for an extension of Cosma's arrest warrant by 30 days on grounds that he "could turn into a public menace" if freed, a court official said.
"Cosma will stay in detention until March 9, pending completion of criminal investigations," the official, who declined to be named, told Reuters.
His lawyer said he would appeal against Friday's ruling. The court had rejected Cosma's request for bail last month.

Prosecutors are investigating Cosma on charges linked to his role in leading thousands of coalminers on a three-day rampage in Bucharest during which three people were killed and the government offices were torched in 1991.
